item.title: Genesee County officials investigate suspicious circumstances behind deadly fire
item.description: A wife and husband were found dead after a fire in their Fenton Township home, and investigators now believe the circumstances are suspicious.Ray and Bev Drzeweicki were killed after flames erupted at their home on Ponema Drive in Fenton Township. The Genesee County Sheriff says he believes something happened inside the home before the fire started."The wife was found near a bedroom window, and the husband was found with a gun case open," said Genesee County Sheriff Chris Swanson. item.title: Former Michigan defensive graduate assistant under investigation for alleged sexual assault
item.description: For the second time in as many months, another scandal rocks the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor. This time, it involves a former coach who was fired from an NFL team on Friday.Ann Arbor police are investigating allegations of a sexual assault. They say the suspect is Latroy Lewis, a former UM defensive graduate assistant and defensive analyst. item.title: Altercation on St. Aubin in Detroit turns into shooting, teen hospitalized
item.description: A teen was shot during a fight in Detroit early Friday evening.Detroit police say at 8:28 p.m., an altercation took place inside a building on the 3400 block of St. Aubin. The fight would continue outside.Officials say shots were then fired by an unknown person, hitting a teenage boy. He was taken to a hospital and is in stable condition. Police are asking if anyone who has information regarding this shooting can call the Detroit Police Department at 313-596-5740 or 1-800-Speak-Up.

item.title: One killed, two injured in Detroit early morning triple shooting
item.description: One man is dead after a shooting early Saturday morning in a Detroit neighborhood.Detroit police say at 4:33 a.m. on Saturday, three men were shot on the 15700 block of Schaefer. It is unknown what led to the shooting as of 12 p.m. Police say one of the three victims has died.FOX 2 will update this report when we learn more.Police are asking if anyone has information, call the Detroit Police Department at 313-596-2260, or Crime Stoppers at 1–800 Speak-Up.

item.description: Police found a 13-month-old baby inside an impounded vehicle in Eastpointe Saturday morning. The vehicle was in a private tow yard, with the child inside, when police arrived. "Our department is in contact with local agencies to investigate the circumstances surrounding the vehicle's impoundment as it was not a vehicle our department had contact with prior to this report," Eastpointe Police said in a statement. item.title: 6-year-old girl in Detroit accidentally shoots herself inside home on city's west side
item.description: A child in Detroit accidentally shot herself after finding a gun in her home, police told FOX 2.Officials say on Sunday, a 6-year-old found a gun inside her home and accidentally shot herself in the shoulder. She was taken to a nearby children's hospital where officials say she is expected to be okay. item.title: State trooper involved in crash on the Lodge freeway
item.description: A Michigan State Trooper and at least one other vehicle were involved in a crash on the Lodge Freeway Sunday evening. The crash happened near Hartwell and James Couzens. The freeway was still closed around 9 p.m. This is a breaking news story and will be updated.

item.title: Pedestrian struck by car on Detroit's east side
item.description: An adult woman was struck by a car while she was in the street on Gratiot near Lappin Road on Sunday evening. Detroit Police said the crash happened at about 6:40 p.m.The woman was taken to an area hospital in critical condition. The male driver of the vehicle stayed at the scene and was co-operating with police.
